sonocraft.state.not_connected: Not connected. Connect in Sonocraft's settings or with /sonocraft connect
sonocraft.status.not_available: Sonolith is not running, or 'Let other apps connect to Sonolith' is off in Settings → Connected apps.
sonocraft.status.not_available.wait: Sonolith is not running, or its API is off. Retrying in %s.

sonocraft.status.already_pending: A request is already waiting in Sonolith. Answer it there.
sonocraft.status.request_closed: Sonolith closed the connection; the request ended.
sonocraft.status.access_ended: Disconnected from Sonolith. Use /sonocraft connect to ask again.
sonocraft.status.revoked_removed: Disconnected from Sonolith: you removed Sonocraft there.

sonocraft.status.disconnected_unreachabl: Disconnected. Sonolith couldn't be reached, so Sonocraft stays in its list until you remove it there (Settings → Connected apps).

sonocraft.feedback.not_connected: Sonocraft is not connected to Sonolith (/sonocraft connect)
sonocraft.toast.onboarding: Connect to Sonolith in Sonocraft's settings (Mod Menu) or with /sonocraft connect.
sonocraft.connection.title: Sonolith connection
sonocraft.connection.disconnect.title: Disconnect from Sonolith?
sonocraft.connection.disconnect.message: Sonocraft will be removed from Sonolith's connected apps. To use it again, you will have to approve it in Sonolith again.
sonocraft.connection.signed_out: Signed out of YouTube: your library and likes need you to sign in in Sonolith.
sonocraft.config.title: Sonocraft
sonocraft.config.connection.manage.descr: Connect to Sonolith, allow more permissions, or disconnect.
sonocraft.config.connection.toasts.descr: Show a notification when Sonolith asks you to approve Sonocraft or when the connection ends.
sonocraft.config.connection.credit.text: Sonocraft uses Sonolith, a desktop YouTube Music client. Sonocraft is not made or endorsed by Sonolith.
sonocraft.config.hud.enabled.description: Show the current song on screen.
sonocraft.config.hud.connection_status.d: When the HUD shows the connection state instead of the song. "Problems only" hides it until something needs your attention.
sonocraft.config.controls.feedback.descr: Show a short message above the hotbar after pressing a playback key.
sonocraft.config.controls.keys: Change the keys in Options → Controls → Key Binds → Sonocraft.
sonocraft.config.theme.mode.description: Where the accent colour of the HUD and UI comes from.
sonocraft.config.theme.manual_color.desc: The accent colour when it doesn't come from the album art.
sonocraft.config.theme.transition.descri: How long the accent takes to change to the next track's colour.
sonocraft.hud.sample.title: Song title
sonocraft.editor.title: HUD editor
sonocraft.editor.hint: Drag to move · Scroll to resize (%s %%)
sonocraft.config.hud.editor.description: Move the HUD with the mouse, resize it with the scroll wheel, or pick a preset.
sonocraft.config.hud.orientation.descrip: Artwork beside the text or above it.
sonocraft.config.hud.text_align.descript: How the text lines line up.
sonocraft.config.hud.padding.description: Space between the edge of the panel and its contents.
sonocraft.config.hud.gap.description: Space between the artwork and the text.
sonocraft.config.hud.max_text_width.desc: Longer lines scroll, or are cut with “…” when scrolling is off.
sonocraft.config.hud.marquee_speed.descr: How fast long lines scroll. Off cuts them with “…”.
sonocraft.config.hud.background.descript: None, a colour of your choice, or a tint of the accent colour.
sonocraft.config.hud.background_color.de: Used when Background is set to Colour. The alpha sets how see-through it is.
sonocraft.config.hud.border.description: A thin line in the accent colour around the panel.
sonocraft.config.hud.hide_nothing_playin: Hide the HUD while Sonolith has no current song.
sonocraft.config.hud.hide_after_paused.d: Hide the HUD after playback has been paused this long.
sonocraft.config.hud.hide_in_screens.des: Hide the HUD while a menu or inventory is open. Chat doesn't count.
sonocraft.config.elements.art.size.descr: Width and height of the artwork.
sonocraft.config.elements.art.shadow.des: A soft shadow under the artwork.
sonocraft.config.elements.icon.enabled.d: Show whether the song is playing, paused or loading.
sonocraft.config.elements.title: Song title
sonocraft.config.elements.text.enabled.d: Show this line. For podcast episodes, Artist shows the author and Album the podcast.
sonocraft.config.elements.time.enabled.d: Show the time played and the length.
sonocraft.config.elements.bar.enabled.de: Show how far the song has played.
sonocraft.config.elements.bar.width.desc: Auto makes it as wide as the text.
sonocraft.hud.sample.lyrics.1: This is how the lyrics look
sonocraft.hud.sample.lyrics.2: Every word lights up as it is sung
sonocraft.hud.sample.lyrics.3: And the next line waits below
sonocraft.config.elements.lyrics.enabled: Show synced lyrics under the song, when Sonolith has them and Sonocraft may read them.
sonocraft.config.elements.lyrics.lines_b: How many sung lines stay visible above the current one.
sonocraft.config.elements.lyrics.lines_a: How many upcoming lines are shown below the current one.
sonocraft.config.elements.lyrics.highlig: Colour the current line word by word as it is sung, when the lyrics have word timings.
Slide to the next line instead of jumping.
sonocraft.config.elements.lyrics.width.d: Auto makes the lyrics as wide as the panel. Longer lines follow the sung word.
